{{Top|leg}}
'''Echo chambers''' were a part of the [[Adnerem]] [[Species/Legends|species]]' anatomy which functioned like the [[Ear/Legends|ears]] found in many other species including [[Human/Legends|Humans]]. They consisted of a hollow chamber located on top of the Adnerem's triangular head, which was similar to a tumor in appearance.<ref name="AJ">[[Star Wars Adventure Journal 11|''Star Wars Adventure Journal'' 11]]</ref><ref name="AE">{{JournalCite|11|Alien Encounters (article series)}}</ref>
